vt_lead: Only statements the application actually delivers on today — nothing that is only meant to come later.
vt_was_p1: Fourwalls is a marketplace for property listings and also offers its own services for owners: sale, letting, valuation, management, and consultation.
vt_was_p2: Company details are given in the legal notice. Some of them are not yet confirmed and are marked as such there.
vt_vertritt_h2: What Fourwalls represents — and what it does not
vt_vertritt_p1: Properties marked "Fourwalls Exclusive" are marketed by Fourwalls itself.
vt_vertritt_p2: All other listings come from private individuals or professional providers. Your enquiry goes directly to that party, not to third parties.
vt_reihenfolge_p1: The regular order of search results cannot be bought.
vt_reihenfolge_p2: Under the "Newest" sort, up to three Fourwalls Exclusive properties may be highlighted — visibly limited in number and marked as Fourwalls Exclusive.
vt_ohneKonto_p1: Searching and browsing properties works without an account. Saved properties, search alerts, and a listing in progress are then kept on your device.
vt_ohneKonto_p2: An account is useful once you want to find the same things on several devices or work as a team.
vt_sprachen_p1: This website is available in German, French, Italian, and English. The language of a consultation depends on availability.
